body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its 10.2M Cyber-shot digital camera 'HX5V/B' at CES 2010, which is equipped with Exmor R CMOS sensor with a 10x optical zoom and 25mm wide angle Sony G lens.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
